lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. Centroids in the anterior section show higher spatial density with smaller radii, while posterior centroids are larger with increased inter-blob distance along the horizontal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where the blobs serve as primary nodes. These vertical stripes exhibit sinuous paths between the circular centroids.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift. The ridges exhibit high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette with a distinct cephalic disk (likely an Echeneidae specimen) is visible ventrally to the pectoral fin, but is an external biological entity rather than a dermal feature.
